intervention_description: Multi-faceted economic inclusion program with core components (coaching, savings groups, entrepreneurship training), psychosocial components, and optional capital transfer

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Cash transfers provided as part of core intervention
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Lump-sum cash grant for productive asset investment
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Village Savings and Loans Association (VSLA) component
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Community sensitization and life skills training focused on social norms and empowerment

outcomes.outcome_name: Gross daily consumption per adult equivalent
outcomes.outcome_description: Total daily household consumption per adult equivalent in USD
outcomes.literal_text: Statistically significant treatment effects on household consumption for all three packages at both follow-ups

outcomes.outcome_description: Inverse Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES), 12-month recall
outcomes.literal_text: Household food security improves by 0.21-0.66, a 6%-20% change relative to control
Dietary diversity improves by 2.71-6.01 points over 7 days (10%-22% improvement relative to control)

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly business revenues per eligible woman in USD
outcomes.literal_text: Business revenues increase by $17-$36 per eligible woman per month, 76%-160% relative to control
Substantial impacts on agricultural revenues in 2nd follow-up for psychosocial and full packages

outcomes.outcome_description: Yearly wage employment earnings in USD
outcomes.literal_text: Limited treatment effects on wage employment
Impacts on livestock revenues statistically significant in 1st follow-up for psychosocial package

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly days worked in household businesses
outcomes.literal_text: Time worked by eligible women in household businesses increases by 2.2-3.7 days per month
outcomes.text_position: Page 26, Table 3, Beneficiary Labor Participation, Column 1

outcomes.outcome_description: Total number of income sources per household
outcomes.literal_text: Number of income sources increases by 0.34-0.49 in 1st follow-up and 0.19-0.38 in 2nd follow-up

outcomes.outcome_description: Livestock count in Tropical Livestock Units
outcomes.literal_text: Livestock count increases by 0.31 units (psychosocial), 0.52 units (capital), 0.80 units (full package)
